hash_vectors.summary: Meaning-bearing destination text changes the hash

cases.given: Grammar 9 Work has a stable ID, non-empty title, and no description or planning element.
cases.when: The document is checked and the Work is listed.
cases.then: The Work is valid uncovered backlog input, has no lifecycle state, and does not affect the strict DAG.

cases.given: A Work associates one project-owned Event but no Activity.
cases.when: Refinement is observed.
cases.then: The desired or premise state is retained without inventing a Do, endpoint-free Activity, or execution authority.

cases.given: Associated Events and Activities form disconnected or cyclic planning fragments with complete Activity endpoints.
cases.when: The Grammar 9 source is validated.
cases.then: The Temporary Draft remains valid but is not schedulable or projectable as an invalid strict fragment.

cases.given: Project POOL contains local Work W1 with title Trusted sign-in.
cases.when: Machine and human identities are projected.
cases.then: The machine result keeps id W1 and qualified_id POOL::W1 while title is mutable, non-unique display text; source rejects :: references.

cases.given: A tracked first-parent history contains a removed POOL::W1 with different meaning.
cases.when: A mutation tries to create W1 again.
cases.then: The creation is unavailable or rejected; incomplete history never proves reuse safe and untracked new documents remain creatable.

cases.given: The document contains three Work declarations in source order C, A, B and work_order A, B, C.
cases.when: Work is listed or a Window filters the project.
cases.then: A, B, C is the only semantic order; declaration movement, title, dependency, and DAG facts do not change it.

cases.given: Split creates S, merge absorbs B into A, and a partial reshape does not request reorder.
cases.when: Candidates are planned.
cases.then: Split requires an insertion anchor, A keeps its former position, B disappears, and all unaffected positions remain exact.

cases.given: A depends on B while B appears later and lies outside a selected Window.
cases.when: The dependency is observed.
cases.then: Direction, order conflict, and uncovered Window coverage are separate advisory facts; no Work is blocked, satisfied, reordered, auto-selected, or made executable.

cases.given: A depends on B and B depends on A.
cases.when: The planning pool is checked and observed.
cases.then: The source is valid, the cycle is prominent and has no advisory ready order, and it is never a valid strict DAG cycle.

cases.given: A reshape affects all incoming and outgoing dependencies of removed Work B.
cases.when: Preflight audits retain, rebind, represented, or no_longer_required dispositions.
cases.then: Every incident pair has one disposition, duplicates coalesce, cited final owners exist, self-internalization is explicit, and semantic equivalence is not claimed.

cases.given: One source description is partitioned exactly into retained and moved semantic rows.
cases.when: A new Work receives the moved rows and the principal Work retains the complement.
cases.then: Both final descriptions reconstruct exactly, no row is copied, and split is one atomic transfer.

cases.given: Absorbed Work contributes every residual row and every typed reference to surviving Work.
cases.when: Merge is preflighted.
cases.then: All meaning and references have one final destination, the absorbed Work and order entry disappear, and no redirect or tombstone remains.

cases.given: A composite reshape introduces asserted-new rows, moves existing rows, and explicitly discards others.
cases.when: The inventory is audited.
cases.then: Every row has one labeled origin and one Work or discard destination; machine audit proves structural conservation but not natural-language novelty or wisdom.

cases.given: An affected non-empty description has a gap, overlap, mismatched source text, duplicate position, or non-reconstructing final text.
cases.when: Preflight runs.
cases.then: PTPOOL-110 rejects the request and issues no token.

cases.given: Equivalent requests differ only in object key order and unordered-set order.
cases.when: Normalization contract 1 runs.
cases.then: They produce the PPRH fixed hash, while destination text or semantic array order changes the hash.

cases.given: A complete valid reshape request is bound to exact source bytes.
cases.when: Read-only preflight succeeds.
cases.then: It returns actual before and candidate descriptions, both decompositions, all mappings and dispositions, exact source/request/candidate bindings, diagnostics, hash, and one opaque token without writing.

cases.given: A caller has only a reproducible preflight hash or caller-chosen salt.
cases.when: Apply is attempted without the registered random token.
cases.then: PTPOOL-111 rejects it; the token uses at least 256 random bits, lasts 3600 seconds, and is not authentication or owner approval.

cases.given: Source, request, normalization identity, candidate, hash, token state, or expiry differs from preflight.
cases.when: Apply re-normalizes and re-audits.
cases.then: It fails with no force or silent refresh and requires a new preflight.

cases.given: A bound apply succeeds, fails before mutation, or is interrupted while committing.
cases.when: Consumption and retry are evaluated.
cases.then: Success including no-op consumes once, pre-mutation failure does not consume, exact old/candidate recovery is idempotent, and a third digest fails unavailable.

cases.given: A reproduced candidate affects the existing dag governance scope.
cases.when: The owner-assertion-free apply preview is returned.
cases.then: It marks the exact user-response boundary and required owner; the LLM records no self-review and cannot substitute the token for a fresh candidate-bound assertion.

cases.given: A selected Event has all associated Work enumerated and a valid final strict candidate.
cases.when: Projection applies.
cases.then: One same-identity Milestone owns the meaning, the Event disappears, and every association becomes one milestone link atomically.

cases.given: A selected Activity resolves both endpoints to existing or simultaneously projected Milestones and has complete strict Task facts.
cases.when: Projection applies.
cases.then: One same-identity Task owns the meaning and all Work associations become task links; incomplete, open, or cyclic strict candidates fail PTPOOL-108.

cases.given: Two Work associate with the same Event and Activity.
cases.when: One caller selects those project-owned entities for projection.
cases.then: Both Work are mandatory affected subjects, each entity materializes once, every association changes globally, and partial per-Work projection is invalid.

cases.given: Projection materializes meaning while a prior non-empty Work description remains parsed-equal and Add residual description is absent.
cases.when: Preflight and apply project the candidate.
cases.then: PTPOOL-112 warns without blocking; an explicit residual, changed value, or cleared value suppresses the warning and no semantic coverage claim is made.

cases.given: Projection or discard removes only Event and Activity Temporary Draft ranges.
cases.when: An in-place candidate passes source, race, validation, and atomic-write gates.
cases.then: Git recoverability is not required for those ranges, exact removal is previewed, and no tombstone or transfer ledger remains.

cases.given: A reshape, archive, or Window mutation removes or replaces Work, order, dependency, link, membership, objective, or Window bytes.
cases.when: In-place persistence is requested.
cases.then: Exact HEAD and stage-0 recoverability is required; separate output is Git-independent and planning commands expose no history-force option.

cases.given: Advance removes strict targets with Work links and some linked Work become otherwise archiveable.
cases.when: dag advance plans cleanup with and without --archive-empty-work.
cases.then: Links are always pruned, Work is archived only under the explicit option and only when newly eligible, AdvanceResult.v4 reports both sets, and existing advance history safety covers the complete candidate.

cases.given: One projected Task is linked to selected and unselected Work and has estimate, actual, completion, and velocity facts.
cases.when: Work, Window, and cross-Window details and aggregates are computed.
cases.then: Each detail may show the complete Task fact, unique totals count its qualified ID once, contribution is non-exclusive, and no Work allocation or retroactive actual split exists.

cases.given: One projected Milestone is linked to selected and unselected Work and owns reach, criteria, receipts, and acceptance.
cases.when: Outcome details and aggregates are computed.
cases.then: Each detail may show the complete Milestone fact, unique totals count its qualified ID once, contribution is non-exclusive, and acceptance does not complete Work, achieve a Window objective, or prove project finish.

cases.given: A shared Task has execution evidence or a shared Milestone is reached or owns criterion or receipt evidence.
cases.when: A reshape tries to split, copy, or reallocate the authoritative fact among Work.
cases.then: The operation is unavailable; independent ownership requires a semantic split before evidence exists.

cases.given: A closed linked strict fragment contains only unstarted Tasks and explicitly selected unreached evidence-free internal Milestones.
cases.when: Deferral is preflighted and applied.
cases.then: Tasks become same-identity Activities, selected internal Milestones become Events, boundary Milestones remain strict, all links restore as associations, and the remaining strict DAG stays valid.

cases.given: The fragment is direct-without-link, active, suspended, completed, actual-bearing, sealed, accepted, criterion-bearing, ambiguous, or needed by retained strict structure.
cases.when: Deferral is requested or a Window closes.
cases.then: PTPOOL-109 makes deferral unavailable and Window operation never invokes it automatically.

cases.given: Two persisted and one ad hoc Window overlap and select shared Work.
cases.when: Window and cross-Window reports are produced.
cases.then: Each pair is unique, no primary Window exists, membership occurrences remain separate, and unique Work, Task, and Milestone totals do not multiply.

cases.given: Windows are unbounded, one-sided, adjacent, overlapping, or incomparable and an explicit compatible observation or project.as_of may be present.
cases.when: Position and intersection are observed.
cases.then: Half-open comparable facts are deterministic, unavailable comparison stays explicit, no wall clock is read, and time passage triggers no lifecycle or DAG mutation.

cases.given: A persisted Window has an outcome-oriented objective and selected execution or outcomes change.
cases.when: The Window is observed.
cases.then: Exact objective text is returned without achieved state and remains separate from Work, Task, Milestone, acceptance, and project finish meaning.

cases.given: Close explicitly discards the temporary objective and lists zero or more carry-over pairs to an existing or fully declared next Window.
cases.when: The history-safe candidate succeeds.
cases.then: The report and contraction are one result, source retains no closed Window, already-selected carry-over does not duplicate, other memberships remain, and Work or DAG facts do not change.

cases.given: Selected Work has residual meaning, partial projections, complete Tasks, accepted Milestones, dependencies, and incomplete evidence in different combinations.
cases.when: Work or Window observation is derived.
cases.then: Refinement, execution, outcome, organization, temporal, archiveability, and close disposition remain independent; no coverage is uncovered and missing evidence is unknown or unavailable, not complete.

cases.given: Current links or Windows were contracted and bounded immutable first-parent history may contain their continuous lineage.
cases.when: A historical Work or Window observation is requested.
cases.then: Exact repository, path, endpoint, commit, blob, digest, validity, and gap evidence is returned; shallow, forced-loss, invalid, ambiguous, raced, missing, or over-limit evidence yields axis-local unknown or unavailable facts and never restores current source.

cases.given: A valid Grammar 8 source is migrated to Grammar 9 without planning declarations, or an older source is used directly with a planning mutation.
cases.when: Migration, strict analysis, and planning mutation are evaluated.
cases.then: Only explicit document migration changes the version, no planning meaning is inferred, strict DAG semantics stay identical, older planning mutation returns PTPOOL-116, and unit migration v5 alone includes Activity candidate values.

cases.given: The contract artifacts are accepted before source implementation.
cases.when: The focused gate compares target catalogs and the current package.
cases.then: Grammar 9, CLI Contract 10, eleven new commands, three new root results, AdvanceResult.v4, UnitMigrationResult.v5, 67 commands, and 26 schemas are reserved while current 0.10.5 Grammar 8 Contract 9 counts and behavior remain unchanged.
